channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio rebate nota do Missão sobre filiação: 'Molecagem'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) presidential campaign criticized the Missão party's note regarding his alleged fraudulent affiliation, calling it 'nonsense' and stating it fails to clarify what occurred. The campaign attempted to register his candidacy with the TSE this morning but was blocked because he was affiliated with Missão yesterday, creating a legal impediment.

item.title: Haddad cobra segurança e critica gestão Tarcísio após ação da PM
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT), candidate for governor of São Paulo, said he needs to feel safe during the electoral process after reporting a suspicious police approach near his home. He also criticized the security management of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans), linking the incident to the state's current public safety policies.

item.title: Prazo para mudar de partido acabou em abril; entenda condições de elegibilidade
item.description: The deadline to change parties for the 2026 general elections ended on April 4, a requirement for eligibility for all offices. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) had his presidential candidacy blocked due to appearing affiliated with the Missão party in Electoral Justice records, despite being the PL's nominee. The TSE denied it was a hacker attack, stating the registration resulted from improper use of credentials by someone affiliated with the Missão party.

item.title: Renan diz que quem filiou Flávio Bolsonaro acessou conta de e-mail do senador para confirmação; cadastro informa 'Rua dos Bandidos' como endereço do candidato do PL
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, claimed that an unauthorized access to Flávio Bolsonaro's email was used to fraudulently enroll the senator in the party, citing internal documents showing a fictitious address ('Rua dos Bandidos'). Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign denies the enrollment and states that the TSE cannot register his candidacy due to this inconsistency, while the Missão party asserts that Bolsonaro's office was aware of the incident and failed to act to correct it.

item.title: Filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao Missão: veja o que já se sabe
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) was unable to register his presidential candidacy after appearing improperly affiliated with the Mission Party in Electoral Justice systems. The TSE ruled out hacking, citing misuse of credentials by someone affiliated with the Mission Party, while the PL filed a disaffiliation request currently under review. The final deadline for candidate registration is Saturday, March 15, at 7 p.m.

item.title: 'Só sabem jogar sujo', diz Flávio Bolsonaro após ser filiado ao Missão; PL aponta fraude, e TSE manda investigar
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro was improperly affiliated with the Missão party, blocking his presidential candidacy registration under the PL coalition. The TSE ruled out hacking, citing misuse of Missão’s credentials, and ordered a judicial investigation and referral to the PGE. Bolsonaro accused opponents of fraud, declaring he will not back down.

item.title: Renan Santos critica Flávio: 'Brasil se ilude com farsa bolsonarista'
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from the Missão party, criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), calling Brazil's belief in the Bolsonarist narrative a 'farce'. He also criticized the federal government during an event in São Paulo's southern zone.

item.title: A explicação do TSE para a filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao Missão
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's affiliation with the Mission party was not due to a hack, but to the improper use of the party's credentials by someone with authorized access. President Nunes Marques ordered a police investigation and referred the matter to the Electoral General Prosecutor's Office. The PL has requested Flávio's disaffiliation, and the request is under review.

item.title: "Só sabem jogar sujo", diz Flávio Bolsonaro após filiação no Missão
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and presidential candidate, denounced alleged fraud in his affiliation with the Missão party, claiming the system is trying to block his candidacy. In a social media post, he stated that those who 'only know how to play dirty' will fail to stop him, as God is on his side and Brazil will prevail. The accompanying video reinforces his narrative of institutional persecution and divine confidence.

item.title: TSE diz que credenciado do Missão filiou Flávio Bolsonaro ao partido e nega ataque hacker
item.description: The TSE denied that Flávio Bolsonaro's affiliation with the Missão party resulted from a hacker attack, stating it occurred due to improper use of the party's own credentials. The TSE president referred the matter to the PGE and ordered a police investigation. The Liberal Party has requested his disaffiliation, which is under review by the Electoral Justice.

item.title: Missão fala em filiação "fraudulenta" de Flávio Bolsonaro ao partido
item.description: The Missão party denounced that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) affiliation with the party was fraudulent, stating the senator’s office was informed of the attempt since August 2 without responding. The TSE ruled out a hacker attack and confirmed the registration was made by a party representative, which is now seeking to reverse the filing and has contacted the PF and Electoral Justice to identify those responsible.

item.title: Lula terá nova reunião com Alcolumbre nesta quinta (13/8)
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) will meet again with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) on Thursday, August 13, following a meeting the previous day at the Alvorada Palace. The restricted meeting aims to rebuild relations and advance three key government priorities: the PEC to end the 6×1 work scale, the Public Security PEC, and the Rare Lands Bill. Government leaders Camilo Santana and Randolfe Rodrigues emphasized the goal is to accelerate votes before the 2026 municipal elections.

item.title: A resposta do Missão sobre a filiação fraudulenta envolvendo Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Missão Party denounced a fraudulent affiliation involving Flávio Bolsonaro, stating its system detected the attempt and tried to cancel it, but the TSE rejected the request. The party said Flávio’s office was notified since May 2 but did not respond to emails. Bolsonaro could not register his candidacy due to appearing affiliated with Missão, and both parties requested a PF investigation.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro aparece filiado ao partido Missão
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, was erroneously linked to the Mission party in TSE systems despite being affiliated with the Liberal Party. The Mission party stated on Thursday that it was a case of fraud and said it is taking all appropriate actions with the Federal Police and the Electoral Court. The incident raises suspicions of electoral data manipulation in an election year.

item.title: Renan Santos e Kim brincam com Flávio no Missão: "Não façam isso"
item.description: Renan Santos and Kim Kataguiri joked about the unauthorized registration of Flávio Bolsonaro into the Missão party, which blocked his presidential candidacy in the TSE system. They stated the filings were made by a party representative, not due to a hacker attack, and Flávio plans to correct the record, possibly involving the Federal Police.

item.title: Fraude barra registro de candidatura de Flávio, que consta como filiado ao Missão no TSE
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) presidential candidacy registration was delayed due to a fraud in his electoral registration, which incorrectly shows him as affiliated with the Missão party instead of the PL. His campaign claims it was a prank and says the issue will be resolved by the end of the day. Missão party states it was the victim of a fraudulent affiliation attempt and says it notified Bolsonaro's team as early as the 2nd of the month.

item.title: TSE adia reunião para discutir IA nas campanhas
item.description: The TSE postponed Thursday's meeting to discuss the limits of AI use in electoral campaigns after the morning plenary session ran longer than expected. A key issue under debate is whether deepfakes should be banned in all cases or only when they risk misleading voters. The decision will influence the evaluation of an AI-generated video of former President Jair Bolsonaro, shared during the convention that confirmed his son Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy.

item.title: O patrimônio de Fernando Haddad declarado à Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) declared a total wealth of R$ 861,217.25 in the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial election, with his largest asset being a financial investment of R$ 359,328.43. His patrimony increased by 44% compared to 2022, when he declared R$ 595,059.29. His main opponent, Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans), declared nearly R$ 2.7 million in assets, representing a growth of approximately R$ 400,000 since 2022.

item.title: Missão diz ser 'vítima' e que alertou gabinete de Flávio Bolsonaro 10 dias antes sobre tentativa de fraude
item.description: The Mission Party claims it was the victim of a fraudulent affiliation attempt involving Flávio Bolsonaro and tried to cancel the affiliation the same day, but the TSE rejected the action. The party says it alerted Bolsonaro’s office on August 2, with emails opened but not answered, and is working with the Federal Police and TSE to identify those responsible. Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL’s pre-candidate for president, cannot register his candidacy due to the irregular affiliation with Mission Party, whose presidential candidate is Renan Santos.

item.title: Lula grava vídeo de campanha para petistas envolvidos no caso Master
item.description: President Lula recorded campaign videos to support three Bahia-based PT politicians implicated in the Banco Master case: Senator Jaques Wagner, former Minister Rui Costa, and Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues. Wagner had over R$ 400,000 seized in a PF raid linked to banker Daniel Vorcaro, while Costa and Rodrigues face scrutiny over the CredCesta payroll-deduction card scheme operated by Banco Master. Lula defends his support by invoking the presumption of innocence, citing the PT’s electoral dominance in Bahia since 2006 and the state’s strategic importance in his presidential victories since 2002.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio prepara ato na Paulista no 7 de Setembro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign is planning an event on Avenida Paulista on September 7th, symbolically tied to past Bolsonarist gatherings, as part of its electoral strategy. The campaign officially launches on Sunday (August 16th) with an act at Copacabana Beach, followed by a motorcycle rally in Juiz de Fora, Minas Gerais—both locations of strong symbolic value for Bolsonarism. These choices aim to replicate the format and symbols used by Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Gaspar nega acordo com Lira para ser vice de Flávio
item.description: Deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) denied having any agreement with Arthur Lira (PP-AL) to be chosen as vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) ticket. He stated he did not approach Bolsonaro to join the ticket and that his nomination was independent. The comment was made in an interview with Meio-Dia em Brasília, from O Antagonista.

item.title: Parte da elite empresarial achou bacana a família de farsantes do Bolsonaro, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate from the Missão party, accused part of Brazil's business elite of having supported Jair Bolsonaro's family and remained silent amid criticisms from his political group, labeling Bolsonarism a 'farce'. He claims these entrepreneurs omitted themselves in the face of what he considers a fraudulent process involving the ex-president's family.

item.title: Se for necessária intervenção na Bahia ou no Ceará, faremos, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate of the Missão party for President of Brazil, stated on Thursday that he may resort to federal intervention in the states of Bahia, Ceará, and Rio de Janeiro if he deems local governments insufficiently combating organized crime. The remark underscores a hardline stance on federal oversight in public security.

item.title: 'Veto a visitas de Flávio Bolsonaro ao pai é legítimo', diz professor
item.description: UFF law professor Gustavo Sampaio stated that the ban on Senator Flávio Bolsonaro visiting his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest, is legitimate, in an interview with UOL News.

item.title: Futuro de Infantino deve ser decidido nas eleições, diz dirigente do futebol africano
item.description: The president of the Confederation of African Football (CAF), Patrice Motsepe, stated that the future of FIFA President Gianni Infantino should be decided in the upcoming elections. The comment was made on Thursday (13) and reflects growing pressure on Infantino amid controversies in FIFA’s governance.

item.title: Flávio Roscoe declara R$ 13,3 milhões em bens ao TSE; veja lista
item.description: Flávio Roscoe, candidate for governor of Minas Gerais from the PL party, declared R$13.35 million in assets to the TSE, highlighting a term deposit at Banco Sicoob worth R$7.23 million, which accounts for over half of his total wealth. The declaration includes 25 items such as real estate, loans to relatives, stocks, and financial investments, marking his first electoral candidacy and asset disclosure to electoral authorities.

item.title: Candidatos à Presidência escolhem lugares ligados às próprias histórias para iniciar campanha
item.description: Presidential candidates in the 2026 race are launching their campaigns from locations tied to their personal and political origins, using symbolic sites to strengthen their narratives. Lula returns to São Bernardo do Campo, where he began as a union leader; Flávio Bolsonaro chooses Copacabana, the political cradle of his family; Romeu Zema starts in Montes Claros; Ronaldo Caiado will tour Goiás; and Renan Santos begins at Largo de São Francisco in São Paulo. Most events are concentrated in the Southeast, with São Paulo as the key electoral battleground.

item.title: TSE reafirma: substituto de prefeito seis meses antes da eleição conta como mandato
item.description: The TSE reaffirmed that vice-mayors who substitute the mayor in the six months preceding an election, even for a short period, have that time counted as a full term, barring them from running for re-election afterward due to the risk of a third consecutive term. The court declined to hear the Rede Sustentabilidade consultation, citing established jurisprudence. The decision was unanimous, with Minister Antonio Carlos Ferreira as rapporteur.

item.title: Como Lula, candidato ao governo do Rio Grande do Norte também usa chapéu em registro oficial: 'Da nossa cultura'
item.description: Allyson (União Brasil) wore a cowboy hat in his official candidacy registration photo for governor of Rio Grande do Norte, defying TSE rules that prohibit head accessories. He justified the choice as cultural identification with the sertão, comparing it to President Lula’s use of a Panama hat due to a scalp tumor and skin sensitivity. The TSE previously allowed an exception in 2022 for Douglas Belchior (PT) on sociocultural grounds, establishing a precedent for such accommodations.

item.title: Quando é a data das eleições presidenciais de 2026?
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian presidential elections will hold the first round on October 4 and the second round on October 25, both on Sundays. Voting takes place from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Brasília time, with adjustments in states outside this timezone to ensure nationwide simultaneity. Voters must present an official photo ID, and citizens over 80 years old have absolute voting priority.

item.title: TSE adia reunião que discutiria proibição do uso de deepfakes na campanha eleitoral
item.description: The TSE postponed Thursday's (13) meeting to discuss a potential broad ban on deepfake use in the 2026 electoral campaign due to a prolonged plenary session. The meeting aimed to debate AI limits in elections, including total prohibition or restrictions only on deceptive uses, along with possible sanctions like warnings and fines. The postponement occurs amid a PT lawsuit against an AI-generated video featuring Jair Bolsonaro's image used during the convention that confirmed Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy.

item.title: Flávio pede correção de filiação ao TSE e campanha deve acionar PF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign claims there was a suspicious alteration in the TSE's party affiliation system, showing him as affiliated with the Missão party and disaffiliated from the PL, blocking his presidential candidacy registration. The legal team requested data correction from the TSE and may involve the Federal Police to investigate a possible hacker attack. The candidacy registration deadline is Saturday, and Missão denied involvement, stating it will open an internal investigation.

item.title: Lula e Alcolumbre terão nova reunião para debater pautas prioritárias do governo no Congresso e eleição
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre will hold a private meeting on Thursday to restart dialogue and advance the government’s priority agenda in Congress, including ending the 6x1 work scale, the Public Security PEC, and the critical minerals and rare earths project. The rapprochement follows three months of silence after the Senate rejected Lula’s nomination of Jorge Messias to the STF, and now aims to pass these measures before the 2026 municipal elections, with the Planalto pushing for swift votes.

item.title: Renan Santos chama Flávio de 'farsante' e diz a empresários que família Bolsonaro 'enganou o Brasil produtivo'
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Missão party, called Flávio Bolsonaro a 'fraud' and accused the Bolsonaro family of deceiving the 'productive Brazil' by gaining support from business sectors in past elections. He criticized the Brazilian business elite for having supported Bolsonarism and remaining silent despite what he views as a deception, stating he attended the event not to make friends but to speak the truth. Renan positioned himself as the only candidate free to confront both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, emphasizing his break with bolsonarism and his commitment to a new political generation.

item.title: Escândalos deram mais engajamento que pesquisas na pré-campanha, diz instituto
item.description: During the week of August 4–10, scandals and investigations generated more social media engagement than opinion polls or electoral rule discussions. The selection of Alfredo Gaspar as Flávio Bolsonaro’s running mate was the most discussed topic, accounting for 23% of thematic content and 38.1 million interactions, followed by the investigation into Lulinha, with 22% of posts and 18.4 million interactions. The Instituto Democracia em Xeque warns that this trend may amplify the influence of denunciations and conflicts in shaping the public agenda ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Flávio aparece no TSE filiado ao Missão; PL diz não ter conseguido registrar candidatura e fala em fraude
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) was unable to register his presidential candidacy after appearing affiliated with the Missão party in Electoral Justice records. His team claims the change was fraudulent and occurred after 11:17 p.m. Wednesday, citing a TSE certificate showing him still affiliated with the PL at that time. The PL alleges possible hacking or forgery, while the TSE investigates the incident.

item.title: TSE adia reunião para debater caso de vídeo usado por Flávio com IA de Bolsonaro e punição a deepfakes
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) postponed its meeting to discuss deepfake regulations in the 2026 electoral campaign to next Tuesday, after the plenary session ran longer than expected. The debate was prompted by an AI-generated video used at the PL convention that replicated Jair Bolsonaro’s image and voice to support Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy, denounced by the Brazil of Hope Federation. Ministers will consider a broad ban on deepfakes and apply fines as initial penalties, reserving harsher sanctions for abuse or repeat offenses.

item.title: Problemas no Banco do Brasil afetam Lula nas urnas? Veja o que diz a CEO
item.description: Banco do Brasil CEO Tarciana Medeiros stated that the bank's decisions are not based on political or electoral cycles, but on macro and microeconomic factors, in response to questions about whether the bank's poor results could affect Lula's potential re-election. The bank reported adjusted net profit of R$ 7.3 billion in the first half of 2026, a 34.2% decline year-on-year, with deteriorating asset quality in the credit portfolio, particularly in agribusiness and individual lending.

item.title: TSE checa registros e diz que filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao Missão foi feita por representante do partido
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) confirmed that Flávio Bolsonaro’s affiliation with the Mission party was made by a party representative without his consent, after he attempted to register as the PL’s presidential candidate. This mirrors the 2024 case involving Lula, whose name was falsely affiliated with the PL, prompting a Federal Police investigation. Bolsonaro’s legal team will request a PF inquiry, citing indications of ideological falsity.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro fecha acordo com o Podemos no Distrito Federal
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) has reached an agreement with Podemos for her Senate candidacy in the Federal District, with support from Governor Celina Leão and Senator Damares Alves. The move expands her outreach beyond the PL, including backing from the local Republicans and participation of allies like former Minister Cristiane Britto. Despite Flávio Bolsonaro’s national isolation due to the Republicans’ neutrality in the presidential race, Michelle is strengthening her local electoral base.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro aparece filiado ao Missão e não consegue registrar candidatura pelo PL
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is unable to register his presidential candidacy after appearing incorrectly affiliated with the Missão party in the electoral system, a situation his campaign attributes to a possible hacker intrusion. His legal team is evaluating a correction request with the Electoral Justice and does not rule out asking for a Federal Police investigation, given the approaching registration deadline on Saturday at 7 p.m.

item.title: Lula muda tom e acena ao agronegócio em novo programa de governo
item.description: President Lula’s (PT) government plan has shifted tone on agribusiness, adopting a more conciliatory approach compared to the 2022 platform, which aimed to distance itself from the Bolsonaro administration. The new strategy seeks dialogue with rural producers, signaling a potential policy adjustment to balance sustainability and economic development. This change reflects an effort to broaden political support in a sector traditionally critical of the PT.

item.title: TSE deve proibir IA de Bolsonaro
item.description: The TSE is meeting to evaluate banning the use of deepfakes and videos of Jair Bolsonaro in electoral campaigns, as he is ineligible per STF ruling and prohibited from political-electoral manifestations. The move aims to prevent PL and Flávio Bolsonaro from using manipulated footage of the former president in propaganda. Meanwhile, the PF is investigating a R$1 billion scheme involving betting, money laundering, and currency evasion, with ties to Bolsonaro-era figures and WhatsApp messages referencing a Lula administration secretary.

item.title: El Gobierno de Trump pide al Supremo que le permita poner en vigor el decreto que limita el voto por correo en las ‘midterms’
item.description: The Trump administration has urged the U.S. Supreme Court to lift a federal judge's block on an executive order that would tighten mail-in voting procedures for the November midterm elections, arguing the restriction is necessary to prevent fraud, while the judge ruled the president oversteps his authority by interfering in state-run elections.

item.title: Tarcísio declara patrimônio de R$ 2,69 milhões ao TSE; Haddad informa R$ 861 mil
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) declared R$ 2.69 million in assets to the TSE, while Fernando Haddad (PT) reported R$ 861 thousand, reflecting his asset trajectory since 2012. Haddad experienced a real 28% loss compared to 2012 after inflation adjustment, but grew 34% since 2022, with wealth concentrated in financial applications and real estate. Tarcísio kept nearly all his assets in a Brasília property valued at R$ 2.14 million, showing a nominal 15% growth between 2022 and 2026.

item.title: MP do fim da taxa das blusinhas fica para setembro e só passa se Congresso se esforçar
item.description: The provisional measure ending the 20% import tax on international purchases under US$50, dubbed the 'blusinhas tax,' had its mixed committee postponed to early September. To avoid expiration, the MP must be approved by September 8, leaving only three days for voting in Congress. While Lula’s improved relations with congressional leaders and the measure’s electoral appeal aid passage, business groups and the opposition resist, fearing it will boost the president ahead of the elections.

item.title: Dino tem muito mais do que a cabeça política
item.description: Lula's nomination of Flávio Dino to the STF was framed as seeking a minister with a 'political head,' but the text argues Dino is a politician by nature and training, maintaining his political engagement even after joining the court. His background, including his tenure as Justice Minister, shows his STF role is not apolitical but deeply embedded in partisan and institutional dynamics.

item.title: Os bens declarados por Antônia Fontenelle, candidata a deputada federal
item.description: Antônia Fontenelle, a federal deputy candidate for PSDB-RJ, declared to the TSE a net worth of R$25,000, consisting solely of shares in Fontenelle Produções Artísticas Ltda., a company tied to her artistic career. She reported no real estate, vehicles, or other investments. Her candidacy is notable for her background as a digital celebrity and controversial YouTube interviewer.

item.title: Ministério da Fazenda autoriza empréstimo de R$ 5,4 bi para São Paulo após Tarcísio acionar STF
item.description: The Brazilian Ministry of Finance authorized a R$ 5.45 billion loan from the Bank of Brazil to the São Paulo state government for infrastructure and urban mobility projects, after Governor Tarcísio de Freitas petitioned the Supreme Federal Court to compel the federal guarantee. The Ministry stated the process follows regular procedure and noted it has approved nearly R$ 30 billion in guarantees for São Paulo since 2023, with annual approvals over three times the historical average. Governor Tarcísio and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro accuse the Lula administration of politically delaying the loans, while the Ministry denies any bias or preferential treatment.
